subject: a_d06_mig_app_w_packing_not_ncg_resize
body:
A-D-06-MIG-01 C note (not a rematch of 082907/081936)

D-06 generated native MIG APP_DATA_WIDTH=128 noted as D evidence, not architecture freeze.
Four 32-bit FEM words per beat is packing arithmetic of that generated width.
Lane placement W0/W1/CRCW/COMMIT within a beat = D media contract.
C word-sequential local FSM remains a local/test model, not DDR crash safety.
NOT FEM_PERSIST_PASS. NOT MIG_PASS.
NCG record widths stay [§02.4]; do not resize to MIG.
